proof:
intro c J a ho hm hp
have hmass : MeasureTheory.volume unitI = 1 := by simp [unitI, Real.volume_Icc]
have h := MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_mono' (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (s := unitI) (f := fun _ => c) (g := fun t => ∑' i, (J i).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => a i) t) measurableSet_Icc hp
rw [MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_const, hmass, mul_one] at h
rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum (fun i => (hm i).aemeasurable)] at h
simpa only [MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator_const (ho _).measurableSet, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply (ho _).measurableSet] using h
